devdoc.author: Renzo Protocol
devdoc.details: This contract manages user deposits and integrates with various DeFi protocols through delegate strategiesWARNING: Rebasing Tokens Should not be used as underlying It supports whitelisting, performance fees, and pausable functionality

InvalidFeeBps().details: Error when fee bps out of range

MismatchedArrayLengths().details: Error when array lengths do not match

NonZeroUnderlyingDelegateStrategy().details: Error when owner tries to remove non zero underlying delegate strategy

NotExchangeRateAdmin().details: Error when caller is not Exchange rate admin

NotPauser().details: Error when caller does not have pauser role

NotRebalanceAdmin().details: Error when caller is not Rebalance admin

NotWhitelisted().details: Error when caller is not whitelisted

NotWithdrawQueue().details: Error when caller is not Withdraw Queue

UnAuthorizedStrategy(address).details: Error when admin tries to execute Non whitelisted strategy

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.

DelegateStrategyAdded(address[]).details: Event emit when delegate strategies added

DelegateStrategyRemoved(address[]).details: Event emit when delegate strategies removed

HighestRateRecorded(uint256).details: Event emitted when highest rate is recorded

Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

PerformanceFeeConfigUpdated(uint256,addr.details: Event emit when performanceFee configuration is updated

PerformanceFeesAccrued(uint256,uint256).details: Event emitted when performance fees are accrued

TotalUnderlyingUpdated(uint256,uint256).details: Event emitted when total underlying is updated

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

VaultInitialized(address,address,uint256.details: Event emitted when the vault is initialized

WhitelistEnabledUpdated(bool).details: Event emitted when whitelist enabled is updated

WhitelistUpdated(address[],bool[]).details: Event emit when whitelist is updated

addDelegateStrategies(address[]).details: Only callable by owner. Strategies must have valid addresses

params.delegateStrategies: Array of strategy contract addresses to add

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `amount` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

burnSharesAndUpdateAssets(uint256,uint25.details: Only callable by the withdraw queue contract

params._assets: The amount of assets to deduct from total underlying
params._shares: The amount of shares to burn

configurePerformanceFee(uint256,address).details: Only callable by owner. Fee must be within valid range (0-5000 bps)

params._feeRecipient: Address that will receive performance fees

decimals().details: Decimals are computed by adding the decimal offset on top of the underlying asset's decimals. This "original" value is cached during construction of the vault contract. If this read operation fails (e.g., the asset has not been created yet), a default of 18 is used to represent the underlying asset's decimals. See {IERC20Metadata-decimals}.

decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically decreases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address. - `spender` must have allowance for the caller of at least `subtractedValue`.

deposit(uint256,address).details: Overrides ERC4626 deposit. Only whitelisted addresses can deposit

params.assets: The amount of underlying assets to deposit
params.receiver: The address that will receive the minted shares

increaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically increases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

initialize(address,string,string,address.details: Can only be called once during deployment via proxy

params._asset: The ERC20 token that the vault will accept as deposits
params._feeBps: The performance fee in basis points (max 10000)
params._feeRecipient: The address that will receive performance fees
params._owner: The initial owner of the vault
params._roleManager: The RoleManager contract for access control
params._withdrawCoolDownPeriod: The cooldown period for withdrawals in seconds
params.name_: The name of the vault token
params.symbol_: The symbol of the vault token

manage(address[],bytes[]).details: Only callable by rebalance admin. All targets must be allowed strategies

params.payloads: Array of encoded function calls to execute
params.targets: Array of delegate strategy addresses to call

returns.results: Array of return data from the executed calls

mint(uint256,address).details: Always reverts. Use deposit function instead

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

redeem(uint256,address,address).details: Always reverts. Users must use the withdraw queue for redemptions

removeDelegateStrategies(address[]).details: Only callable by owner. Strategies must have zero underlying value before removal

params.delegateStrategies: Array of strategy contract addresses to remove

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params._isEnabled: Boolean value indicating if whitelist is enabled

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

trackUnderlying().details: Only callable by exchange rate admin. Used to sync vault state with strategies

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `amount`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `amount`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `amount`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

updateWhitelist(address[],bool[]).details: Only callable by owner. Arrays must have matching lengths

params.accounts: Array of addresses to update whitelist status for
params.status: Array of boolean values indicating whitelist status

updateWhitelistedEthSender(address[],boo.details: Only callable by owner. Arrays must have matching lengths

params.accounts: Array of addresses to update ETH sender whitelist status for
params.status: Array of boolean values indicating ETH sender whitelist status

withdraw(uint256,address,address).details: Always reverts. Users must use the withdraw queue for withdrawals

devdoc.title: LEZyVault

addDelegateStrategies(address[]).notice: Adds new delegate strategies to the vault's allowed list

burnSharesAndUpdateAssets(uint256,uint25.notice: Burns shares and updates the total assets accordingly

configurePerformanceFee(uint256,address).notice: Configures the performance fee and fee recipient

deposit(uint256,address).notice: Deposits assets into the vault and mints shares

initialize(address,string,string,address.notice: Initializes the vault with configuration parameters

manage(address[],bytes[]).notice: Executes multiple management actions on delegate strategies

redeem(uint256,address,address).notice: Redeem is not supported directly - use withdraw queue instead

removeDelegateStrategies(address[]).notice: Removes delegate strategies from the vault's allowed list

trackUnderlying().notice: Updates the vault's total underlying asset value

updateWhitelist(address[],bool[]).notice: Updates the whitelist status for multiple accounts

updateWhitelistedEthSender(address[],boo.notice: Updates the ETH sender whitelist status for multiple accounts

withdraw(uint256,address,address).notice: Withdraw is not supported directly - use withdraw queue instead

userdoc.notice: Main vault contract implementing ERC4626 standard with additional yield strategies
